what: A four-stop gradient of two fill colors and two rest colors is laid over the button background at 300% so the rest-color side shows. On hover it slides to the left edge over .3s linear, and the fill color slides in smoothly from the left. On release it exits to the right — the calm fill for menu rows, contact buttons and See more buttons

options.--fx-fill: (css variable) color shown on hover, default --kf-raised — the contact button uses --kf-accent-text
options.--fx-rest: (css variable) resting color, default --kf-bg — dark button uses --kf-ink, button over video is transparent

use: See more
